stem: Flowering is a process that occurs in many plants to ensure reproductive success. Which statement MOST DIRECTLY describes the interactions needed for flowering to occur?

options.label: A
options.text: A hormone triggers the production of pigments that travel to the flower and initiate blooming.

options.label: B
options.text: Water is absorbed through the plant’s shoots to increase the leaf’s ability to support the opening of flowers.

options.label: C
options.text: Plants respond to environmental factors by producing hormones needed for flowering.

options.label: D
options.text: Warmer temperatures increase the rate at which water and nutrients are transported to the flower bud by traveling through the phloem.
